snippet.title: Boba Teashop Refill | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
The Boba Teashop - Refill is coming to PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S

Developed in collaboration with Mike Ten, creator of The Boba Teashop, this new first-person psychological horror game puts you behind the counter of a newly opened boba teashop.

Play as Maya, take customer orders, prepare drinks, and survive each shift as an ordinary service job gradually turns into something far more disturbing.

Demanding customers, negative reviews, strange noises, unsettling encounters, and an increasingly oppressive workplace begin to distort Maya’s everyday routine.

Take the order. Make the drink. Keep the customer happy.

Finish your shift. Whatever happens, don’t lose your job.
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
